cluster_reason: TypeUtils, TypeLiteral and Typed form a cohesive type-handling subdomain: TypeLiteral depends on TypeUtils and TypeUtils references Typed. They have strong internal interactions and are conceptually focused on type representation/processing, so moving them together isolates type-related logic without splitting tightly coupled helpers.

blocks.goal: Move the selected cluster (type-related classes) into a dedicated subpackage to reduce God Component size.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect.type if it does not exist.
Move TypeUtils to the destination package to group type utilities with related classes.
Move TypeLiteral to the destination package so its implementation sits alongside TypeUtils.
Move Typed to the destination package to keep the type representation interfaces with their utilities.
